ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field comprising approximately 90% of the visible surface, contrasted by a high-intensity white focal region at the central base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Ventral surface is primarily a contiguous dark grey-to-black region. A distinct, high-contrast white patch of irregular geometry is located at the center just below the median notch. Scattered high-intensity white point-sources (pixel clusters) are distributed across the dark field, primarily near the lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression dividing the lobes with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge featuring high-frequency serrations. The right lobe exhibits deeper, high-amplitude valleys and peaks compared to the left lobe, which shows more moderate, rounded serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves originating from the center and sweeping outward and upward towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (calcified organisms) concentrated on the right lateral tip and left lateral tip. Individual circular white nodes are also visible on the mid-lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (diagonal rake marks) are visible across the dark pigment of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of calcified surface growth on distal tips. Minor nicks and irregular tissue loss along the trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of brownish-orange organic material attached to both lateral tips. A highly unique, centralized white pigmentation mark at the fluke's pivot point.
